quotes.text: # Build a subscriptions integration with Elements
Create and manage subscriptions to accept recurring payments with Elements.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: On the back end, create the subscription with an `incomplete` status using `payment_behavior=default_incomplete`.
1. Verify the subscription status. If it’s `active`, your user has paid for your product.

The Accounts v2 API is generally available for Connect users, and in public preview for other Stripe users. If you’re part of the Accounts v2 preview, you need to specify a [specify a preview version](https://docs.stripe.com/api-v2-overview.md#sdk-and-api-versioning) in your code.

findings: The 2026-11-07 capture is a 14-line variant index, not a replacement behavioral guide. Its two links at new raw lines 13-14 correspond to both paths already present in the old 3003-line capture. The wholesale diff therefore reflects changed rendering/capture shape and cannot support a deprecation, removal, or new payment behavior claim. Keep the new index out of factual raw_files.

The mapped source summary at line 13 frames this same old raw as a Checkout Sessions guide only, while old raw lines 1115-1133 also contain a distinct Payment Intents integration. Update its scope or split path descriptions within the existing source, with each path's client secret and confirmation flow kept separate.

The source webhook table at line 82 says customer.subscription.created means grant access. The old Payment Intents path creates an incomplete subscription before payment (old lines 1503-1510, 1967, 2377), and the old provisioning instructions require status verification (old lines 2633-2641). Change the row to record/check state; condition paid access on the appropriate active status or active entitlement, with trial access separately qualified.

The source client sample at lines 45-59 uses loadActionsResult.actions and actions.confirm without showing checkout.loadActions or defining actions. Old Checkout guide lines 449-464 and 594-617 supplies that step; repair or clearly label the fragment as partial so readers do not treat it as runnable.

The source Accounts v2 line 129 and linked concept line 208 state API version 2026-03-25.dahlia as a universal requirement. Old raw lines 267-273 distinguish Connect general availability from public preview for other users and specify a preview version when participating in preview. Keep the dated example version and availability condition distinct.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The old guide contains both Checkout Sessions with ui_mode elements (old lines 10-30, 349-430, 449-464, 594-617) and a lower-level Payment Intents route (old lines 1115-1133, 1503-1510, 2429-2449, 2461-2492); do not conflate the Checkout Session client secret/actions.confirm with the invoice PaymentIntent confirmation secret/stripe.confirmPayment.

The Payment Intents route intentionally creates an incomplete subscription before first payment and then follows payment status; subscription creation alone is not a paid-access signal (old lines 1503-1510, 1967, 2461-2492, 2633-2641).
The old Accounts v2 availability and preview-version distinction is dated evidence, not current eligibility proof (old lines 267-273 and 1384-1390).
The cancellation example deletes the subscription immediately and says a canceled subscription cannot be reactivated (old lines 791-804 and 2680-2694); this does not describe cancel_at_period_end.
conflicts: Existing source line 82 unconditionally grants access on customer.subscription.created, conflicting with the old raw's incomplete-before-payment example and status check; wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md lines 63-64 and 85-87 already carry the proper paid-versus-trial qualification.

Existing source line 129 and wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md line 208 make the specific Accounts v2 API version unconditional, while the old raw line 269 says preview participants need a preview version and Connect users have general availability.
unresolved_questions: The new index does not include either linked variant's current body, so this exact capture cannot establish whether either path's detailed instructions changed since the old raw; separately authorized variant collection would be needed for a current-content comparison.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/advanced/build-subscriptions, the 2026-11-07 capture is a variant index (new raw lines 5-14), linking Checkout Sessions and Payment Intents variants at lines 13-14. The old capture already contained both routes (old raw lines 10 and 1115), so the large diff is navigation/capture restructuring, not evidence of a substantive change or deprecation. [[source-stripe-build-subscriptions-elements]] should preserve the old path-specific facts as dated evidence and should not add this navigation-only capture to factual raw_files.
answers.Q2: [[source-stripe-build-subscriptions-elements]] needs an existing-source correction for https://docs.stripe.com/payments/advanced/build-subscriptions: source line 13 hides the old Payment Intents route (old raw lines 1115-1133), and source line 82 grants access on subscription creation despite the incomplete prepayment example (old raw lines 1503 and 1967) and explicit status check (old raw lines 2633-2641). The new raw's lines 11-14 only point to variants; they cannot establish current flow changes. Repair the partial Checkout actions sample and qualify Accounts v2 version/availability as dated old-raw conditions.
